name: Araki Mihaya
source:
"But you were standing up for me, so I couldn't just abandon you."

A 15-year-old high schooler in Class 1-A.

He can always be found reading in the library. Due to a past incident, he doesn't trust other people and prefers to be alone, but stands up for himself when necessary.

[From [url=https://www.aksysgames.com/paradox/characters/]official website[/url]]
